newsitem.title: USA: ONBANCorp opposes holder's merger plan.
newsitem.headline: ONBANCorp opposes holder's merger plan.

text.p: ONBANCorp Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Bennett said Wednesday that a proposed merger or sale of the bank by Seymour Holtzman, the bank's largest individual shareholder, would lead to an expensive and disruptive proxy fight if pursued.

Bennett's assessment was issued this afternoon within hours after it was disclosed that Holtzman had requested the shareholder list and was considering nominating five outside directors with a mandate to sell the bank.
Bennett said the move would not be in the best interest of stockholders.

Bennett added that Holtzman was the "behind-the-scenes leader" of a group of stockholders which attempted to submit various shareholder proposals at its annual meeting earlier this year. None of those proposals passed.
Holtzman has contended that the "dismal performance" of the bank's stock reflects a lack of a "sound strategy to enhance shareholder value."
